name: artifacts-canvas
description: Collaborative annotation canvas over artifacts: shared protocol + client + server.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared -w server && tsx dev/dev.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run e2e -w client && npm run e2e:server -w client
